News & Awareness

Anti-Corruption AwarenessCorruption affects public services, trust and development. Responsible reporting can help increase awareness.
Evidence MattersWhen sharing a complaint, describe the facts clearly and distinguish personal experience from assumptions.

Community ResponsibilityThe platform is intended for awareness and responsible community discussion.

Help Desk

How to create a report?Select a complaint category, describe the incident, optionally attach photos or videos, then choose whether you want to post anonymously.
How does Anonymous mode work?Your public post displays an anonymous identity instead of your profile name.
Account SecurityNever share your username or password with anyone. Each username is unique.
Content ResponsibilityDo not use the platform to spread knowingly false claims, threats, harassment or private information.
